method: Independent model linguistic review of all 500 roots, every supplied English meaning and Spanish semantic definition, in batches of 50. One useful source-grounded subject-preserving predicate selected where reliable; not approval from source membership alone. Renderings are original educational paraphrases, not dictionary quotations or native-human certification. Necessary technical, regional, register and construction restrictions are retained in context/notes. Mandatory pronominal roots and unresolved causative/subject or homograph paradigms are withheld. Frozen English frames avoid unfilled internal object slots; explicit lexical arguments such as a bow, wine, a blanket or sleep are supported by the source meaning rather than invented real-world participants. Aspect modes are selected readings, never blanket used-to. No English past/participle overrides supplied: the existing verified inflection/sense guards must remain in force. Lexical review does not assert actual translation coverage of the potential children.
